cases.question: Under the proposed historical bank provision, when does a transaction require a SAR?
cases.expected_information_need: Identify the transaction nexus, aggregation threshold and suspicion conditions together.
cases.proposed_answer: Paragraph (a)(2) combines a bank nexus, at least $5,000 individually or in aggregate, and specified knowledge/suspicion conditions. Paragraph (a)(1) also permits voluntary reports.
cases.exceptions_and_qualifications: Do not turn the amount alone into a filing decision. Preserve exceptions, timing and confidentiality; charter-specific Title 12 rules are outside this candidate corpus.

cases.question: Which AML program elements apply to a bank with or without a Federal functional regulator?
cases.expected_information_need: Distinguish paragraphs (a) and (b), their common elements and incorporated requirements.
cases.proposed_answer: Both categories include controls, independent testing, responsible personnel, training and risk-based ongoing CDD. Paragraph (a) incorporates regulator rules; paragraph (b) requires a written program and governing-body approval.
cases.exceptions_and_qualifications: Confirm actual bank category. Sections 1010.610, 1010.620 and full 1010.230 and regulator rules are not independently covered; do not claim complete program compliance.
